source_merging: metric calculation only; sum EAS and SEA in both truth and prediction before computing TV
mask_policy: both observed masks, averaged within person; no pooling people with masks as independent samples
development_cohort: same 43 calibration and 127 validation people as the completed guided8 screen; preserve all reference and training identities and original roles

finalists.incumbent: full-reference native EM, states100, update-p=false, initial generation10
finalists.last_slot: one accepted copying-regularization candidate; otherwise the existing full-reference EM states280 candidate

last_optimization.scope: 43 calibration people, both masks, chr22 only; no validation or test scoring
last_optimization.if_no_candidate_passes: stop optimizing; use the three existing native finalists

reporting: per-source pure and mixed ancestry MAE, bias, p95 and off-target calls
test_policy: lock one winner using validation only; evaluate that winner once on the original untouched test role; no additional tuning or model selection using test results
caveats: validation has been reused during development; the leaderboard is not an independent accuracy estimate
pure-source labels are operational population annotations, not measured individual biological admixture
family components, masks and related individuals are not IID samples
no production promotion before the final results and held-out test are reviewed
